decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system is a multi-model line with substantial development investment, and it is central to the announced direction toward flexible workplace interiors, so commitment to it is strong.
The chair family sits close to the core offer and was visibly showcased on its own page, so the firm would persist with it and treat any weak sales as temporary pandemic effects.
The carpet floor cushions are a niche accessory, but the firm has invested in a multi-model line and ties it to its sustainability and material expertise, so it is kept despite modest relevance.
The soft upholstered sofa is core residential business that the firm promoted to its own page in 2019, which signals growing commitment and makes dropping it unlikely.
The high standing table fits the flexible office and lounge strategy and needs little extra investment, so the firm continues it.

The rug collection is distant from the core offer and is the most vulnerable product, but the public commitment to a curated multi-model collection and its link to interior solutions favor persisting with it for now.
